scope: Full-PC build create flow in the admin Catalog workspace (new PC builds tab with a slot-based configurator) and the storefront model page component summary. The admin catalog also returns to per-category Attributes after the attribute-set removal.

businessFlow.subject: Signed in as the demo admin, opened the Catalog workspace PC builds tab, created a full PC build whose component slots mix 'select existing' parts (CPU/Motherboard/RAM/Storage) and an 'add new part' inline entry (a custom GPU with a typed VRAM spec), saved it atomically, and verified the storefront model page renders the build's server-derived Included components summary.

notes: Verified headed against the local dev stack (admin :3001, web :3000, api :4000). The backend POST /api/v1/admin/product-model-builds atomically created the BUILD model, the inline part (with typed spec value), and the product_model_components links; GET /api/v1/product-models/:id returned the components array rendered read-only on the storefront. Test rows created during the click-through were deleted afterward.
